newsitem.title: USA: Rogers chairman Birkenruth to quit in '98.
newsitem.headline: Rogers chairman Birkenruth to quit in '98.

text.p: Rogers Corp said Thursday that Harry Birkenruth,its chairman of the board, will retire from full-time service to the company next year.
The company also said that, as previously announced, Walter Boomer will succeed him in the positions of president and chief executive on March 31.
Birkenruth has held those positions since 1992.

Boomer is a retired General and Vice Commandant of the U.S. Marine Corps, the second highest position in the Corps, and was Commanding General of all Marine forces in Desert Storm. He most recently served as President of the Babcock & Wilcox Power Generation Group of McDermott International Inc.
